posts.caption:
Black Friday, one year ago 🎧

While everyone was out shopping, Jessie J put out her sixth album, Pink Siifu dropped ONYX'! as a whole second chapter to BLACK'!ANTIQUE, A$AP Ferg brought Gucci Mane onto Flip Phone Shorty, and Sega Bodega went full ambient.

Which of these four is still on your phone a year later?

Found an artist before everyone else? Riffex is where fans back them early. Join the waitlist at riffex.app.

#rewind #jessiej #pinksiifu #asapferg #segabodega
